scope: LOCAL_ONLY delivery candidate, immutable target versions, manifest/hash verification, history and withdrawal

implementation.approval_gate: build_delivery requires latest non-stale APPROVED EPISODE_RENDER_VERSION review
implementation.immutable_output: each subsequent build uses a unique local delivery directory; first legacy-compatible path is never overwritten; partial directory is atomically renamed
implementation.manifest: delivery-manifest.v3 records render/timeline source hashes, target version/spec, encoding probe, subtitle revision, audio/license evidence, controls and file SHA-256/size
implementation.verify: repeatable file path/symlink/size/hash checks plus canonical manifest hash; tamper identifies the file and marks CORRUPT
implementation.target_versioning: DeliveryTargetVersion create/select API retires prior active version without modifying packages
implementation.history_withdraw: episode history, package/files read APIs, local download, immutable delivery events, and idempotent WITHDRAWN marker; verify preserves WITHDRAWN when files remain intact
implementation.transport: only LOCAL_FILESYSTEM; absolute, traversal and remote targets are rejected

required: tamper and withdrawn history screenshot evidence

notes: Automated local fixture proves the implementation and negative paths; formal production UAT and release evidence remain outstanding.
